title: EFC Background No-Go Theorem: Why Background-Level Modification Cannot Suppress Structure Growth
abstract: Shows, via three independent parametrisations and a BAO–CMB joint analysis, that any EFC background H(z) modification large enough to improve BAO is decisively ruled out by CMB distance priors. The result is structural (due to DA(z*) integrating through z < 2) and closes Level 3: the EFC background is effectively ΛCDM at current precision, redirecting viable EFC dynamics to the perturbation sector.
